name: DotPagination
description: Row of round dots indicating carousel/slideshow position. Knockout styling (white dots) — designed for dark or media surfaces.

props.name: count
props.description: Number of dots, clamped 1–5 (mirrors Figma's Show Dot 1–5 booleans; defaults match Figma: dots 1–3 on)

props.name: activeIndex
props.description: Zero-based index of the active dot, clamped to count

props.name: ariaLabel
props.description: Accessible name for the nav landmark

props.name: onSelect
props.description: Optional click handler receiving the selected dot index

notes: Dots are real <button> elements inside a <nav> landmark — keyboard operable (2.1.1).
Active dot carries aria-current='true'; each dot has an aria-label naming its slide (4.1.2).
Focus ring uses focus-ring/knockout for visibility on the dark surfaces this component targets (2.4.7).
8px hit area is below the 24px target-size guideline (2.5.8 AA) — acceptable as an inline indicator, but pair with adjacent prev/next controls for primary navigation.
Figma component is knockout-only (white dots on dark) — no on-light variant exists in the set; do not invent one.
Figma caps at 5 dots via Show Dot 1–5 booleans; the count prop mirrors that clamp.
